non_stop_double_buffer_2018.title: A Non-Stop Double Buffering Mechanism for Dataflow Architecture

facts.fact: On-chip memory is divided into two alternating buffers so PE computation and DMA transfer use different halves.
The tile index selects the buffer by tile_idx modulo two; memory addresses are relative to one buffer.
Per-buffer buf_acc ownership distinguishes PE access from DMA access and completed-block counters release a tile.
The PE request carries buffer position, relative address and tile index; the buffer selects a half with tile_idx modulo two.
The workflow copies results out before copying the next tile in, then transfers ownership to the PE; the array fills and drains once across one DFG.
The model uses SimICT, an 8x8 PE array, 32 instruction slots per PE, eight blocks in flight and FRFO.
The source configuration is 8 MiB SPM, 32 banks, 256 bits per bank, 64 GB/s memory bandwidth and a 1 GHz clock.

operand_ram_conflict_2019.title: Optimum Research on Inner-Instruction Memory Access Conflict for Dataflow Architecture

facts.fact: The SimICT configuration uses a 1 GHz ARM host, 4 GiB DDR4, a 1 GHz 4x4 PE array, eight operand-RAM slices, two 64-bit XY networks and 3 MiB SPM.
The host copies instructions and input data into the accelerator through DMA, starts the microcontroller, then copies results back through DMA after completion.
Operand RAM is organized as RAM slices; same-instruction operand conflicts stall the pipeline and are distinct from SPM bank conflicts.

look_ahead_acknowledgment_2022.title: Accelerating Data Transfer in Dataflow Architectures Through a Look-Ahead Acknowledgment Mechanism

facts.fact: The cycle-accurate SimICT model is calibrated against gem5 within 9 percent and uses a SimpleScalar-derived host.
During network congestion, incoming contexts are held in a PE input buffer; its capacity covers the pre-fire queue.
The source configuration has 4 MiB data SPM with 16 banks at 256 bits per bank and 4 MiB instruction SPM with eight banks at 1024 bits per bank.
The system uses 16 GiB DDR4, four physical 4x4 mesh networks, 64-bit packets and one cycle per hop.
The selected pre-fire queue contains eight entries; this is flow-control evidence, not an SPM timing parameter.

mlx_2026.title: MLX: Multi-Layer Execution for Structured LLM Workload Acceleration on Spatial Architectures
mlx_2026.path: MLX Multi-Layer Execution for Structured LLM Workload Acceleration on Spatial Architectures/MLX Multi-Layer Execution for Structured LLM Workload Acceleration on Spatial Architectures.md

facts.fact: The disclosed MLX system contains a host controller, scratchpad memory and a PE mesh.
The scratchpad uses SIMD-striped rows and row/column access so FFT and BSMM intermediates remain array-resident.
Stage transitions use explicit scratchpad shuffles/round trips when a larger closed set cannot remain in one compact footprint.
